claim.raw_value: the Indemnified Parties to whom this Section 5.8 applies shall be third party beneficiaries of this Section 5.8, each of whom (including his or her heirs, executors or administrators and his or her Representatives, successors and assigns) may enforce the provisions of this Section 5.8)

shall pay (or cause to be paid) the reasonable fees and expenses of counsel selected by the Indemnified Parties promptly, and in any event within ten (10) days, after statements therefor are received and otherwise advance to such Indemnified Party upon request, reimbursement of documented expenses reasonably incurred

attributes.why_unmapped: ADVANCEMENT_TIMING: Counsel fees and expenses are payable promptly and no later than ten days after receipt of statements. Documented expenses are advanced on request.

claim.raw_value: provided, that if legally required, the person to whom expenses are advanced provides an undertaking to repay such advance if it is determined by a final and non-appealable judgment of a court of competent jurisdiction that such person is not legally entitled to indemnification under applicable Law

attributes.why_unmapped: ADVANCEMENT_TIMING: An undertaking to repay an advance is required if legally required and a final non-appealable judgment determines no legal entitlement to indemnification.

claim.raw_value: none of Parent, the Surviving Company or the Surviving OpCo shall be liable for any settlement effected without Parent’s prior written consent (which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed)

attributes.why_unmapped: CLAIMS_HANDLING: Settlements require Parent’s prior written consent, which cannot be unreasonably withheld, conditioned, or delayed.

claim.raw_value: none of Parent, the Surviving Company or the Surviving OpCo shall be obligated under this Section 5.8(a) to pay the fees and expenses of more than one legal counsel (selected by a plurality of the applicable Indemnified Parties) for all Indemnified Parties in any jurisdiction with respect to any single legal action except to the extent that, on the advice of any such Indemnified Party’s counsel, two or more of such Indemnified Parties shall have conflicting interests in the outcome of such action.

attributes.why_unmapped: FEE_SHIFTING: One counsel is covered for all indemnified parties in a jurisdiction and action, subject to conflicting interests.

claim.raw_value: Parent shall cause proper provision to be made so that the successors and assigns of the Surviving Company or the Surviving OpCo, as the case may be, shall assume the obligations set forth in this Section 5.8.

attributes.why_unmapped: SUCCESSOR_ASSUMPTION: Successors and assigns must assume the Section 5.8 obligations.

claim.raw_value: The contractual indemnification rights set forth in Section 5.8(d) of the Company Disclosure Letter (the “D&O Agreements”) in existence on the date of this Agreement with any of the current or former directors, officers or employees of the Company or any Company Subsidiary shall be assumed by the Surviving Company and the Surviving OpCo without any further action, and shall continue in full force and effect in accordance with their terms following the OpCo Merger Effective Time.

attributes.why_unmapped: INDEMNIFICATION_AGREEMENT: Existing D&O Agreements are assumed without further action and continue under their terms.

claim.raw_value: whether asserted or claimed prior to, at or after the OpCo Merger Effective Time

attributes.why_unmapped: PENDING_CLAIM_SURVIVAL: Indemnified liabilities may be asserted or claimed before, at, or after the effective time.
